name: Block Slide
description: The frame is cut into a grid of blocks that slide out one after another in a staggered cascade, some of them shrinking as they go, while the blocks of the second clip slide in behind them to take their place. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: columns
params.description: Number of block columns (at most 40 along the direction)

params.name: rows
params.description: Number of block rows (at most 40 along the direction)

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction the blocks slide toward, rounded to the nearest axis (x right, y up)

params.name: stagger
params.description: Part of the transition over which the blocks set off one after another (0: all together)

params.name: zoom
params.description: How much the zooming blocks shrink on their way, as a part of their size

params.name: background
params.description: Color seen in the gaps between the blocks
